verdict.rationale: Highnote's issuing docs say it can create "tokenized digital cards". In a card-issuing context that plausibly means wallet tokens, but this is a single thin mention that never names Apple Pay or Google Pay. Missing for 10: documented push provisioning from the developer's app, documentation of the Apple and Google entitlement processes, in-wallet card art configuration, an explicit manual-provisioning fallback, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
